verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense's own materials say every card transaction is "controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant" (docs-9), and its API lets you set up budgets, users and virtual cards (docs-2). That suggests budget-based spend controls, but there is no explicit evidence of a codified expense policy that routes only exceptions to a human. The rule-based approval policy docs (docs-39) cover AP bill approvals, not expenses, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented expense-policy rules with limits by category, role and context, auto-approval of in-policy expenses, exception-only routing to human approvers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
